groups.definition: New or higher tariffs and trade agreement changes increase costs of imported vehicles, parts and materials, which mitigation may not fully offset.

groups.canonical_name: Tariffs and export controls disrupting trade
groups.definition: New or increased US and China tariffs, export controls and sanctions disrupt the company's ability to trade and sell products.
China-Taiwan tensions and restricted entity lists could decouple global trade and technology supply chains, disrupting operations.
Chinese government actions may restrict non-Chinese companies' access to critical materials needed for production.

groups.canonical_name: Currency volatility and cash transfer restrictions
groups.definition: Exchange rate swings and restrictions on transferring cash out of China affect financial results and liquidity.
Violations of export controls, sanctions, foreign investment rules or anti-corruption laws could lead to penalties and restrictions.
Large customers may curtail purchases due to sourcing policy changes, tariffs, export controls or other trade measures.

groups.canonical_name: US-China tensions restricting repatriation and exports
groups.definition: US-China tensions may restrict dividend repatriation from China and technology exports.
